sql_reading_A.sql: SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.FULL_NAME, s.EMAIL_ADDRESS, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS school_rank FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY s WHERE s.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
